note: Part-specific household refs for middle-east-north-africa. grams_per_unit follow USDA household weights, cited in basis; suite refs are never redefined here.

paprika_tsp.basis: USDA: ground paprika 1 tsp ~2.2g, rounded to 2g to match the suite's smoked_paprika_tsp density

allspice_tsp.basis: USDA: ground allspice 1 tsp ~2.1g, rounded to 2g

ground_coriander_tsp.basis: USDA: ground coriander 1 tsp ~1.9g, rounded to 2g

dried_mint_tsp.basis: dried leaf herbs ~1g/tsp, same basis as the suite's oregano_tsp/thyme_tsp

dill_tbsp.basis: fresh leafy herbs ~2g per tbsp chopped, matching the suite's parsley_tbsp/cilantro_tbsp/mint_tbsp basis

sumac_tsp.basis: dried ground berry spice ~2g/tsp, same basis as the suite's chili_flakes_tsp

pomegranate_molasses_tbsp.basis: molasses-density syrup, same basis as the suite's maple_syrup_tbsp (20g/tbsp)

pitted_kalamata_olive_piece.basis: USDA canned ripe olives: large 5.2g, jumbo 6.9g each; pitted kalamata rounded to 5g
